title: Marketing Apes Domain Foundation
description: One deterministic manifest per tenant covering the locked Universal Domain MCP capability surface. Campaign, job and runtime configuration are structurally invalid here: every object is closed (additionalProperties:false), so campaign_id, lead_lane, buyer, offer, budget, routing and similar cannot appear at any depth. Identity sharing is generic across all identity-bearing capabilities via owner_tenant_id + shared_with, never network-specific. No secret material of any kind is stored.

campaign_state.description: literal declaration that campaigns are not stored here
